about: MWManager's own notes for option choices, shown in the option window after the FOMOD text, the packaged readmes and the mod page. A mod matches by its Nexus id or by a package-folder pattern; each option pattern is matched (case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards, / or \) against the option's label, key, file name and path inside the package. '*' notes the whole package. An option's value is a note, or {"note": ..., "needs": [plugin, ...]}: a chosen option waits until those plugins are installed, like a missing master.

options.*AATL_Data.esp: Modder's resource: this plugin is for mod authors working in the Construction Set. Players do not need it; leave it unchecked.

options.*Firemoth Remover*: Only enable this plugin if you would prefer the official add-on version of Siege at Firemoth. Tamriel Rebuilt includes an extensive overhaul of that add-on, and this plugin removes it.

options.*2D Moss*: Significantly smaller files for users with lower-end systems. It overwrites the larger 3D moss meshes in the main mod. If your system is modern and capable, leave this unchecked.

options.*Windoors*: Windoors is a very hard to find mod from a Russian author. If you do not have a copy, or a reasonable idea how to get it, don't install this patch.

Dark Molag Mar*.note: A patch for the separate mod Dark Molag Mar (on Nexus), not part of Glow in the Dahrk. Its meshes (Meshes\rtfmm\) only do something when Dark Molag Mar is installed; without it, leave this unchecked.
